internal_name:
음식/식품 관련 알레르겐
(Egg White, Milk, Soy bean, Maize, Sesame, Crab, Shrimp, Potato, Apple, Cacao, Peach, Mackerel)
definition: maximum sensitization class for the food allergen panel (egg white, milk, soy, maize, sesame, crab, shrimp, potato, apple, cacao, peach, mackerel)
mean maximum sensitization class across the seven allergen panels
count of individual allergens with a sensitization class of 2 or above, summed across the seven allergen panels; set to zero where the panel was not performed
history of allergic rhinitis + asthma + other allergy (0-3)
count of prior treatments recorded, out of five: topical corticosteroid, topical calcineurin inhibitor, systemic corticosteroid, cyclosporine and methotrexate
maximum of the erythema, papulation, excoriation and lichenification scores
baseline head-and-neck EASI / baseline total EASI
history of allergy other than rhinitis or asthma
dyslipidemia in the past medical history
cyclosporine among the previous systemic treatments
